capabilities: Toggle pinning of Editing Toolbar's fixed bottom toolbar via hotkey or command
Keep Editing Toolbar's top toolbar visible even in reading view
Choose between bottom-pin and top-pin modes in settings
Apply bundled appearance fixes (fullscreen background, dark-mode skin, auto-hide timing)
extras: Beta builds can be installed via BRAT; the settings page, command name, and notices are localized in English and Simplified Chinese, with more languages added as data entries. The README states no network access, telemetry, or accounts.
intentEvidence: Both pinning modes act on toolbars that Editing Toolbar provides, so this plugin does nothing on its own.
motivation: The author found the bottom bar genuinely useful on a desktop but tied to editor focus, and the top bar too hard to reach while reading, so they added a single pin toggle bound to one key.
problem: Editing Toolbar's bars hide on fixed rules — the bottom bar only shows while the editor is focused and the top bar vanishes while reading — and neither behavior is configurable.
summary: Companion plugin that pins Editing Toolbar's bottom or top toolbar permanently visible via a single hotkey toggle.
